label.purpose: Uppercase phase, count, and state metadata.

shadows.name: lifted-roster-tape
shadows.purpose: Restrained pointer-hover lift for movable player strips only.

motion.name: roster-tape-lift
motion.purpose: Moves and shadows player strips by one pixel on hover when reduced motion is not requested.

components.name: App Header
components.description: Ruled match-card header with the condensed wordmark, phase label, and live status.
components.css: .ds-app-header { height:66px; padding:12px 14px 9px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink); background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); } .ds-brand { display:block; font:700 30px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-brand span { color:var(--green); } .ds-app-header small { display:block; margin-top:2px; font:600 11px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; color:var(--graphite); } .ds-live { border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:999px; padding:10px; font:700 14px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Full-width forest-ink progression action for the current workflow step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width:100%; min-height:58px; border:0; border-radius:3px; background:var(--ink); color:#fff; padding:0 18px; font:700 18px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#203b2c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a67d3; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Shared Live Pill
components.description: Compact status-and-share control that stays distinct from paper work surfaces.
components.html: <button class="ds-live-pill" aria-label="Share game link"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>2 live</button>
components.css: .ds-live-pill { min-height:44px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); padding:0 10px; font:700 14px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-live-pill:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.28); } .ds-live-pill:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a67d3; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-live-pill:active { background:var(--paper-deep); }

components.name: Coach Text Field
components.description: Bold, nearly square field for coach and roster names on the paper ledger.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">LEFT COACH<input class="ds-input-coach" value="Alice" aria-label="Left coach"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; color:var(--ink); font:600 13px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.03em; } .ds-input-coach { width:100%; min-height:44px; margin-top:6px; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:2px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.35); color:var(--ink); padding:0 10px; font:700 18px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; } .ds-input-coach:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.5); } .ds-input-coach:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a67d3; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Arrival Check-In Row
components.description: Numbered attendance cell whose text state keeps the green check-in signal accessible.
components.css: .ds-checkin-row { width:100%; height:48px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:28px 1fr auto; align-items:center; border:1px solid var(--rule); background:rgba(255,255,255,.28); color:var(--ink); padding:0 7px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-checkin-row strong { font:700 16px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; } .ds-arrival-number { color:var(--graphite); font:700 16px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; } .ds-arrival-state { color:var(--graphite); font:700 9px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-checkin-row.ds-is-checked { border:2px solid var(--green); background:#e3f1e6; } .ds-is-checked .ds-arrival-state { color:#116f47; } .ds-checkin-row:hover { border-color:var(--ink); } .ds-checkin-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a67d3; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Shared Clock
components.description: Three-part ruled clock with separate stop and start destinations and an explicit state label.
components.css: .ds-clock { height:70px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 104px 1fr; border:1px solid var(--ink); background:var(--paper-deep); color:var(--ink); } .ds-clock button { min-width:0; border:0; background:transparent; font:700 17px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-stop { color:#7b3333; border-right:1px solid var(--ink) !important; } .ds-start { color:#176843; border-left:1px solid var(--ink) !important; } .ds-clock-running .ds-start { background:var(--green); color:#fff; } .ds-time { display:grid; place-content:center; text-align:center; } .ds-time strong { font:700 27px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-time span { margin-top:4px; font:600 9px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-clock button:hover { filter:brightness(.94); } .ds-clock button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a67d3; outline-offset:-4px; } .ds-clock button:active { filter:brightness(.86); }

components.name: Player Placement Strip
components.description: Movable name-only strip whose fluorescent border exposes fairness without prescribing a move.
components.css: .ds-player-strip { width:100%; min-height:48px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:4px; border:3px solid rgb(10 157 97); border-radius:3px; background:#fbf6eb; color:var(--ink); padding:0 8px 0 10px; cursor:grab; transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-player-strip strong { font:700 18px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; } .ds-player-strip svg { color:#536057; } .ds-player-strip:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 4px 9px rgba(20,40,29,.12); } .ds-player-strip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a67d3; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-player-strip:active { cursor:grabbing; transform:translateY(0); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-player-strip { transition:none; } .ds-player-strip:hover { transform:none; } }

components.name: Coach Side Handle
components.description: Horizontal drag handle that swaps complete left and right coach field columns, with press as an accessible alternative.
components.css: .ds-coach-side { min-width:76px; min-height:44px; border:0; background:transparent; color:#536057; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; gap:4px; padding:0 2px; cursor:ew-resize; touch-action:none; } .ds-coach-side span { font:700 9px/1 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-coach-side:hover { color:#14281d; } .ds-coach-side:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a67d3; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-coach-side:active { color:#0b7447; }

narrative.overview:
The Touchline Match Card treats the phone as a weatherproof paper ledger held at the edge of a game: compact, tactile, and legible in a distracted outdoor setting. Cream stock, forest ink, graphite rules, condensed headings, and fluorescent roster-tape edges create a specific physical world without turning the interface into a literal soccer pitch.

Its energy comes from compressed information and purposeful marks rather than decoration. Rules divide working areas, tabular numerals steady the shared clock, and colored borders expose fairness while player names remain the dominant content. The system guides judgment but never draws a prescribed move; placement stays fully in the coaches' hands.
keyCharacteristics: Weatherproof cream paper with a faint vertical stock texture
Forest-ink typography and graphite ledger rules
Condensed, uppercase operational headings paired with highly legible body text
Fluorescent roster-tape borders as the quiet fairness signal
Dense, one-handed controls with explicit states and almost-square corners

rules.name: The Tape Does the Talking Rule
rules.body: Fairness color belongs on the player strip's border; the name remains plain forest ink and the accessible label carries the non-visual meaning.

rules.name: The Condensed for Command Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for headings, labels, counts, and clock controls; reserve Atkinson Hyperlegible for names, instructions, and editable content.

rules.name: The Rule Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate content with ink and graphite lines first; reserve shadow for the moment a movable strip lifts from the paper.

dos: Do keep player names, attendance states, and clock direction readable without relying on color alone.
Do use condensed uppercase type for operational hierarchy and Atkinson Hyperlegible for human names and instructions.
Do preserve the cream-paper, forest-ink, graphite-rule material stack across new surfaces.
Do let rules, dense grids, and explicit labels carry structure before adding depth or decoration.
Do keep critical touch targets at least 44px high in ordinary phone layouts.
Do label coach setup fields by physical side and keep side swapping available through both horizontal drag and press.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a literal soccer pitch or use field markings as decorative chrome.
Don't convert the fairness signal into a prescribed substitution, ranked recommendation, or displayed minute calculation on the placement strip.
Don't fill player cards with red or green; fairness stays on the fluorescent roster-tape border.
Don't introduce rounded dashboard cards, soft floating panels, or broad shadow stacks into the paper-ledger world.
Don't collapse explicit STOP and START destinations into an ambiguous clock toggle.
